title: The Blind and Mute Demon-Possessed Man
description: Jesus heals a demon-possessed man who is both blind and mute, so that he can see and speak. The people wonder if he is the son of David, but the Pharisees accuse Jesus of casting out demons by Beelzebul. Jesus answers that a kingdom divided against itself cannot stand, and that he casts out demons by the Spirit of God – a sign that the kingdom of God has come. He warns against blasphemy against the Holy Spirit, which cannot be forgiven.
